_about: Corrections to individual federal closure sites, keyed by stable site id (tools/fsa_ids.py). The federal file is never edited; the build applies these on top and keeps the reported value. Each entry needs a reason.

fsa-18915.reason: Federal file gives state CO for Colton, 92324. The Census geocoder matched 1090 E Washington St, Colton, CA 92324 exactly on ZIP; Colton, CA is the address.

fsa-19543.reason: Federal file gives state ND, ZIP 00000, for 5920 Castleway W Dr, Indianapolis. Matched to Indianapolis, IN 46250.

fsa-22084.reason: Federal file gives state AL for 6562 Stanford Avenue, Garden Grove, ZIP 92645. Matched to Garden Grove, CA.

fsa-16119.reason: Site is in Sanford, FL (ZIP 32772, University of Florida - Seminole CC). The Census geocoder matched a Weldon Ln address in Sanford, NC (27330), so its coordinates are wrong and are withheld.
